text:
maria_cs: Customer (Acme) reporting 413 when calling POST /v1/rerank. Payload is large: ~3.4MB, query ~55k chars, ~120 docs (~1k each). They expect an error that explains which limit was hit and suggested next steps. Attached customer curl and logs below.

opsbot: Automated response from gateway: HTTP 413
Response body: {"error":"input_size_exceeded", "message":"payload too large"} 
Server-side token accounting (telemetry): max_input_tokens=65536, received_input_tokens=120432

eli_se: Thanks — can you paste the exact request shape (fields sent) and the model name? rerank counts tokens across query + all documents; looks like they exceeded our token ceiling not char limit.

maria_cs: They used model: redwood-reranker-v1, body fields: {"query", "passages": [{"id","text"} ... ]}. Customer included titles + full doc bodies. They want a suggested customer message and a repro we can run.

ben_infra: Quick notes: 1) We currently return a generic 413 without structured details. 2) We can add limit fields to the error payload (e.g. "limit_tokens": 65536, "received_tokens": 120432, "limit_type": "tokens"). 3) Telemetry already logs per-doc token counts but we don't expose them in API responses for privacy.

eli_se: For support reply, ask customer to: (a) try trimming the query to <10k chars or split into multiple queries, (b) reduce # of passages or send only snippets, or (c) run a local token-count to confirm. Also offer a small example cURL to reproduce.

sophie_prod: Customer-facing template suggestion: "Your request exceeded our per-request input size. Try sending fewer documents or shorter queries. If you need help splitting documents, we can recommend a snippet/aggregation pattern. See KB: https://kb.redwood.com/rerank-input-limits" :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Can we provide a minimal repro here so SRE/infra can reproduce quickly? I want an exact curl we can run that triggers the 413.

eli_se: Minimal repro (replace X-API-Key):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "redwood-reranker-v1",
    "query": "'$(python -c \"print('Q'*55000)\")'",
    "passages": ['$(python -c \"import json; print(','.join([json.dumps({'id':i,'text':'D'*1000}) for i in range(120)])) )')']
  }'
```

ben_infra: Repro looks good. Ops follow-ups: - Add a short-term support-only enhancement: return error JSON with numeric fields (limit_tokens, received_tokens). - Medium-term: make error more actionable with suggested_action enum: ["truncate_query","split_docs","use_embeddings_then-rerank"]. - Long-term: surface per-route token breakdown in Console and include a KB generator for snippet-splitting.

maria_cs: For the support message to the customer, propose this text: "We're seeing your request exceed our per-request token quota (tokens: 120,432 > limit: 65,536). This triggers a 413. Please reduce the number of documents per request or shorten the query. As a workaround, you can send document snippets or run per-doc embeddings + a smaller rerank set. If you want, we can help split their corpus — attach a sample and we'll provide a chunking strategy."

eli_se: I'll add the repro to a private incident so infra can run it. Ben — can you draft the quick error-payload change? We can ship to prod behind a feature flag.

ben_infra: Yep — I'll put up a PR with schema update to include limit fields and suggested_action. I'll exclude per-doc counts from API response but will record them in telemetry. ETA: EOD tomorrow behind ff.

sophie_prod: Also logging for product: request-level UX: change the 413 message to include approximate size numbers (tokens or bytes) and a short 'how-to-fix' link. This should cut down tickets.

maria_cs: Great — I'll update the customer with the template and offer assisted chunking. Attachments: customer payload (sanitized) and gateway logs above.

eli_se: Thanks — keep us posted if customer needs a warm-handoff to Solutions for custom chunker.
